subject: Sync to fiscal window and onramp: Helix renewal & capacity sequencing
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@helixanalytics.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lee <m.lee@helixanalytics.com>
Date: 2028-09-15 09:12 -0700
Subject: Aligning renewal to our FY + onboarding ramp

Mina —

We’re starting internal planning for next year and want to move our Redwood renewal to match Helix’s fiscal year (starts 2029-01-01). Current contract runs calendar-year. Two asks:

1) Can we shift the term boundary so future renewals align to our FY without overpaying for the current partial period?
2) We expect a 3x usage ramp over the first 6 months next year. Need a recommended capacity/onramp schedule and any pricing smoothing you can offer (we’re open to a multi-year commitment if it helps).

Also procurement asked us to confirm invoice cadence (quarterly vs annual) and whether auto-renew can be disabled for enterprise deals.

Can we get a short proposal (options + financial delta) by EOD Friday? Would like to review with finance.

Thanks,
Elena
Head of Product Operations
Helix Analytics

--
Elena Soto

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>

Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-15 11:45 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aligning renewal to our FY + onboarding ramp

Elena —

Thanks for the clear asks. Quick summary of feasible options (attachments: Helix_Renewal_Options_2028.xlsx):

Option A — Short correction (recommended fast path)
- Add a one-time pro-rated bridge: extend current term to 2028-12-31 and then start new FY-term 2029-01-01. No extra charge for overlap; we credit unused months.
- Keep single-year commitment; add ramp addendum with defined tiers for months 1–6.

Option B — Multi-year smoothing (best for unit price stability)
- 24-month term starting 2029-01-01 with a 6-month measured ramp (token bands set). 6% blended discount across committed capacity; true-up annually.
- Invoice cadence: quarterly or annual available; recommend quarterly for cashflow alignment.

Governance items
- Auto-renew: for enterprise we can set auto-renew off by default and require a 90-day window to exercise renewals (we document in SOW).
- Co-terming: if you want to align other vendors we can do a co-term amendment but that requires a short bridge credit (see Option A).

Attachments: Helix_Renewal_Options_2028.xlsx (pricing scenarios), Redwood_SOW_v3.docx (blank SOW template).

If you’re okay, I’ll map Option B into a draft SOW and a proposed DocuSign envelope for your legal/procurement.

Proposed next step: 30-min sync Thurs 9/16 noon PT to walk numbers?

- Mina
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
Phone: (415) 555-2034

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@helixanalytics.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-16 08:05 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aligning renewal to our FY + onboarding ramp

Elena, Mina —

Quick operational notes to feed the proposal:

- Ramp profile: to hit 3x in 6 months we recommend a staged burst policy: 100% baseline (months 0–1), 175% (months 2–3), 300% (months 4–6). This keeps latency SLOs and avoids hot-cache cold-starts.
- Dedicated vs Hosted: if Helix wants predictable throughput during ramp, Dedicated GPU pools with a burst band is the safest. We can include an early-burst credit in Year 1 to offset front-loaded costs.
- True-up mechanics: monthly metrics export + quarterly reconciliation. We’ll include token-level cost breakdown in the SOW.

I’ve sketched the ramp into the SOW template (Redwood_SOW_v3.docx). Also uploaded an internal ops readiness checklist here: https://drive.redwood.com/s/helix-onboard-readiness (link for your ops/infra team).

If procurement needs SOC2 artifacts we can provide the report; attaching a placeholder SOC2-evidence-stub.pdf for now and will exchange formal artifacts through your compliance intake.

Camila Reyes
Customer Success — Redwood Inference

Subject: PO template and invoicing cadence

Mina / Elena —

We reviewed the Option B outline and are generally comfortable with a 24-month arrangement provided the following are included in the SOW:

1) Invoice cadence: quarterly invoices with Net 45 payment terms (we will not accept annual prepay for this contract).
2) Non-auto-renew clause: must be explicit.
3) Cancellation/exit: 90-day notice with pro-rata refund for unused committed portion.
4) Please embed the PO number HLX-PO-5592 in all invoices and the SOW.

We’ll circulate a PO template we expect Redwood to accept. If you can produce a DocuSign-ready SOW that respects the above, procurement will sign and issue the PO within 5 business days.

Thanks,
Helix Procurement
